items.statement: After accounting for overlap and review quality, the best available evidence will show a reduction in inappropriate lumbar imaging orders with decision support, but with low certainty.
items.rationale: Consistent direction across reviews; low quality and overlap.

items.statement: Tools that require a structured reason to override will be associated with larger effects.
items.rationale: Supported by the override review and heterogeneity in the low back pain review.

items.statement: No review will report effects by language, and few by deprivation.
items.rationale: The equity mapping found 4 of 38 studies with subgroup results.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 frames the main synthesis.
